correctness.rationale: Exact integer resultant calculations show the two symmetric bidegree-(3,3) divisors cannot both be singular on the affine chart in any characteristic outside 2,3,7; exact Groebner unit ideals prove smoothness in these three cases (B for 2 and 3, A for 7). Boundary charts explicitly exclude projective singularities in every characteristic. Smooth ample (3,3) curves have genus four and canonical smooth Segre quadric. Quadratic Galois factor-swap descent preserves the symmetric equations and a smooth rational point, while exchanging the two and only geometric g^1_3 pencils, forbidding k-trigonal maps. Riemann--Roch on K-2P gives a k-pencil of degree at most four, proving gonality exactly four. Both attached programs were replayed successfully.
